The '''Skills package''' modified basic chemicals in the brain in order to enhance general problem solving and data processing abilities. It allowed for a minor improvement in the completion of skill-related tasks, making it a valuable implant of its type.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, the playable character must have a constitution attribute of 12 or higher.
